raw_formula.input: reconstructed raw physical-unit trial before fold standardization
raw_formula.mean_std_formula: RMS across the three sensor axes of left/right summary difference
raw_formula.energy_formula: RMS across axes of log(mean(x^2)+epsilon) left/right difference
raw_formula.gravity_formula: acos(cosine(mean_acc_left,mean_acc_right)); kinematic gravity-direction proxy; zero when either mean norm<=epsilon because direction is undefined
raw_formula.frequency_formula: RMS difference of per-axis |rFFT(x-mean(x))|/n, DC excluded, linearly interpolated to fixed normalized-frequency bins

anchor_rules.uncertain: neither stable nor change; excluded from boundary supervision

model_alignment.model_frame_policy: include one right-padded partial tail frame when needed
